name: XDS 喜德盛 GT350
why_interesting: A dated mainland price lead, an exact Hong Kong build sheet and public ownership context make the GT350 unusually well documented for an entry gravel bike, although market trims differ.
missing: Exact mainland drivetrain, wheels, brakes, weight and included accessories
Proof that the mainland price maps to the documented Hong Kong trim
Current seller, warranty, and return route

facts.brakes: Hong Kong build: L-TWOO hydraulic disc
facts.frame: Hong Kong build: X6 aluminum frame and carbon fork
facts.frame_material: X6 aluminum frame with carbon fork; exact aluminum alloy series and fork fiber grade are not published for the documented Hong Kong trim
facts.frame_construction: Internally routed X6 aluminum gravel frame with carbon fork; exact tube-forming, joining and fork lay-up processes are not published
facts.stiffness_evidence: No meaningful exact-model measured stiffness result or sufficiently specific independent ride assessment was found for the documented Hong Kong trim
facts.wheels: Hong Kong build: 30 mm double-wall alloy rims
facts.complete_weight_basis: Exact Hong Kong retailer claim; size, pedals, accessories, tire pressure and weighing method are not stated
facts.mounts: Owner report notes multiple rack and bottle-mount provisions

source_note: Public observations span a roughly ¥2,800 promotion, ¥3,790 negotiated purchase, ¥4,500 list context and listings around ¥5,000. The retained ¥4,698 observation is the dated marketplace record; price and trim are channel-sensitive. The current Hong Kong exact trim supports 11.05 kg but not a mainland-SKU mapping or complete weight basis. A separate GRX/carbon-wheel custom build was reported below ¥10,000 and about 9.5 kg, but those figures are not stock-bike facts.
